messages:
morgan: Hey folks — first week here! I accepted the GitHub org invite but I can't clone repo `redwood/runtime` (403). GitHub UI shows I’m not in any teams. Anyone who handles org permissions? my work email is morgan@redwood.ai

devex: welcome @morgan 🎉 DM'ing you the checklist. Quick q — did you accept with your work email or a personal account?

morgan: accepted with work email. I see the org in my account but under People it lists me as just an account, no teams.

morgan: trying to clone shows:```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood/runtime.git
Cloning into 'runtime'...
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```

priya-onboard: Hi Morgan — I can take this. Can you confirm the exact GitHub username (not email)?

morgan: my github username is morgans-obrien

priya-onboard: thanks. I'm checking the org invites... one sec.

github-bot: Invitation resend to morgans-obrien (morgan@redwood.ai) created by priya-onboard.

jamal-devops: Two common issues: (1) invited email != GitHub account email, (2) SSH key not added. If you still see 403 after accept, check Settings -> Emails on GH to confirm work email is verified.

morgan: confirmed work email is verified on GH. I can log into the org page but team membership is empty. Also I don't see a prompt for 2FA when I accepted — is that required?

jordan-security: We do require 2FA for org access. If you haven't enabled it GitHub will prevent certain actions until it's on. Enable via Settings -> Security -> Set up two-factor authentication. Docs: https://help.github.com/en/articles/securing-your-account-with-two-factor-authentication

priya-onboard: Morgan — I manually added you to the "eng-runtime" team and re-sent a membership invite. Try to accept (top-right bell) and then attempt to clone. I also flagged 2FA requirement in the invite flow.

morgan: got the team invite, accepted. Trying clone again...

morgan: clone works now, thanks! :tada: I had an SSH key missing from my GitHub account. Added the key and everything is smooth.

jamal-devops: For future onboarding, run this to add your key locally:
```bash
eval "$(ssh-agent -s)"
ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
```

priya-onboard: Great — I'm going to mark the invite flow as verified for your account. Welcome to the eng-runtime team @morgan! If you hit permission hiccups on other repos ping #eng-platform or me.

morgan: thanks everyone — super fast help. Appreciate it! :pray:
